judged_text: When no topic exists, the controller enqueues RetrieveTopic and renders 'loading', but the job's retrieve path silently no-ops on every failure (throttled within 60s, embed_url host mismatch, embed_by_username user missing, fetch error), and loading.html.erb blindly reloads every 30s. A user embedding a URL whose retrieval fails gets an iframe stuck in 'Loading Discussion...' forever — the failure of a user-facing operation is completely invisible, with no error state ever rendered.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no topic exists it always enqueues `:retrieve_topic` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), and `loading.html.erb` unconditionally reloads every 30s. The retrieval path can legitimately no-op without surfacing any error: `TopicRetriever#retrieve` skips `perform_retrieve` when `invalid_host?` is true (embed_url host != `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, and the controller does not validate `embed_url` host—only `request.referer`), and `fetch_http` returns immediately if `embed_by_username` user lookup yields blank. In these cases no `TopicEmbed` is created and the iframe will stay on the loading page indefinitely with repeated reloads and no error state.
